resolution_verdict.alternative_8: Accepted: explicitly states that monotonicity constraints alone do not guarantee fairness, preserving the baseline limitation and citation scope.
resolution_verdict.alternative_11: Accepted: explicitly distinguishes contributions separated throughout the computation from the final-score positive and negative parts, preserving the internal-stream distinction.
resolution_verdict.conclusion: All requested semantic restorations are resolved; authorized MNIST mechanism-investigation framing remains intact. No further prose changes required.
